name: evc-team-relay-mcp
description: MCP server for reading and writing Obsidian vault documents via EVC Team Relay

relay_cp_url.title: Control plane URL
relay_cp_url.description: Team Relay control plane, e.g. https://cp.tr.entire.vc for the hosted service or your own self-hosted URL.

relay_agent_key.title: Agent key
relay_agent_key.description: Per-share agent key (recommended; required for writes). Create it in Team Relay under Shares, Agent keys.

relay_email.title: Email (read-only fallback)
relay_email.description: Account email, used only when no agent key is set.

relay_password.title: Password (read-only fallback)
relay_password.description: Account password, used only when no agent key is set.
